description: A Lottie or dotLottie animation from an https address, controlled by props (ANI-005).

props.name: url
props.description: The https address of the `.json` or `.lottie` file.

props.name: repeat
props.description: Whether it plays again when it ends.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Whether every second play runs backwards.

props.name: progress
props.description: The frame to show, 0 to 1; when set it does not play.

props.name: fit
props.description: How it fits its box, a `BoxFit` name.

props.name: width
props.description: The width, or the animation's own.

props.name: height
props.description: The height, or the animation's own.

props.name: reduceMotion
props.description: What it does under reduce motion: `skip` shows the last frame, `shorten` plays four times as fast, `ignore` plays as declared.

props.name: semanticLabel
props.description: What the animation shows; without one it is hidden from screen readers.

events.name: onCompleted
events.description: Fires when an animation that does not repeat ends.
